title: Five-point characterization of closed immersions of algebraic spaces
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For a morphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces over S, being a closed immersion is equivalent to each of: universally closed + unramified + monomorphism; universally closed + unramified + universally injective; universally closed + locally of finite type + monomorphism; universally closed + universally injective + locally of finite type + formally unramified. The retained proof is written out in two moves: the equivalence of the last four conditions follows from the chapter's lemma that universal injectivity equals monomorphism-ness for unramified maps, and then both directions reduce to representability of f (from the closed-immersion side and from the universally-closed-plus-unramified side), after which the schemes case cited from Etale Morphisms finishes. Retained author proof at lines 2920-2927.
